name: Carin Jager-Wind
reason: Health rule and too thin: her site praktijkbodie.nl (Praktijk Bodie, Netherlands) presents one €45 treatment session sold on a list of complaints (muscle and joint pain, back and hip misalignment, menstrual and menopause complaints, inflammation, sports injuries, burn-out), plus animal treatments; nothing else (workshops, videos, free resources) would remain.
